front.title: Media over QUIC Relay Fabric Protocol

abstract.t: This document defines moq-fabric, the relay fabric protocol used by Media over QUIC ([MOQT]) relays to exchange node, announce, and subscribe information and to forward objects between relays. The fabric is split into control peering and data peering. Control peering stays established and carries the information bases. Data peering carries objects and MAY be pre-established or opened on demand. The two functions MAY share one QUIC session or use separate sessions. A fabric session uses mutual TLS, together with an OPTIONAL token for authentication and authorization, before the peers exchange fabric state.
